tools.name: get_clinic_information
tools.description: Contacts, addresses, opening hours, licence and the three clinics of EKO-IKSI, a fertility (IVF / ICSI) clinic in Tashkent, Uzbekistan. Use this to tell someone how to reach or visit the clinic.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: The treatments and services EKO-IKSI and its two partner clinics offer, grouped by the sections of their price lists. Without `clinic`: an overview of all three clinics' sections and how many services each holds. With `clinic`: every service of that clinic by name. Use search_prices for the prices t

tools.name: search_prices
tools.description: Search the price lists of EKO-IKSI and its two partner clinics in Tashkent (IVF, ICSI, consultations, tests, procedures). Prices are in Uzbek so'm. Search works in Uzbek, Russian or English.

tools.name: list_doctors
tools.description: All doctors of EKO-IKSI clinic: name, position, specialties and experience, with a link to each profile. Use get_doctor for one doctor's full biography.

tools.name: get_doctor
tools.description: One EKO-IKSI doctor's full profile: position, specialties, experience and biography. Pass the id from list_doctors, or part of the doctor's name.

tools.name: list_articles
tools.description: Every article and news item EKO-IKSI clinic has published, newest first, page by page: title, type, date and link. `type` picks the blog (article), the news (news) or both; follow `next_page` until it is null to see them all. Use search_articles to find one by topic and read_article for the text.

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search the articles and news EKO-IKSI clinic has published about infertility, IVF, ICSI, andrology, gynaecology and the clinic itself. Returns titles, dates, summaries and links; use read_article for the full text, and list_articles to see every publication.

tools.name: read_article
tools.description: The full text of one EKO-IKSI article or news item. Pass its URL (from search_articles, or any eko-iksi.uz article address) or its slug.
